prompt: Write a recorded statement transcript (about 250 words) between an insurance adjuster (lines start with 'Q:') and the claimant (lines start with 'A:'). The claimant was the driver in a side impact at intersection in Conroe, Texas, and has neck and back strain. No names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1382; do not mention it.)
text:
Q: Thank you for taking the time to speak with me today. This recorded statement concerns the collision at the intersection in Conroe, Texas. Please state your full name for the record.

A: I'd rather just keep it to the accident itself, if that's okay.

Q: That's fine. Can you walk me through what happened as you remember it?

A: I was going through the intersection on a green light. Another vehicle came from my right side and went through the red. It hit the passenger side of my car pretty hard.

Q: Were you able to stop or swerve before impact?

A: No. It happened so fast. I hit the brakes but there wasn't time to do anything else.

Q: Did you hit your head or lose consciousness?

A: I didn't black out. My head didn't hit anything I know of, but my body got thrown against the door and then back toward the middle of the car.

Q: How are you feeling now?

A: My neck is stiff and sore, and my lower back aches, especially when I sit for a long time. I've been taking over-the-counter pain relievers and using a heating pad.

Q: Have you seen a medical provider since the collision?

A: Yes, I went to an urgent care clinic that same day and was told I had strains in my neck and back. I've been doing some physical therapy exercises at home.

Q: Did you have any neck or back problems before this collision?

A: Not that I'd call serious. I had a little stiffness now and then from desk work, but nothing that stopped me from doing my normal activities.

Q: Thank you. Is there anything else you'd like to add?

A: Only that I'm hoping to get my car looked at and to get back to normal soon.

Q: Thank you for your time. This concludes the statement.
